scope: The same132IT2a groups in complete f45r and f89r1.6–10; no new corpus,image,source,heldout or reserve.
proposed_content: DAIIN supplies one shared unknown positive integer c as the cardinality of its local nominal group argument. This is a proposed quantitative meaning, not wholly uninterpreted syntax and not an identified number.

types.individuals: One underlying domain of individuated members. Membership/individuation must be supplied independently of the requested count, not changed per occurrence to satisfy it.
types.kind: Each unchanged whole-description label X denotes one unknown kind predicate Kind_X on members; different kinds may overlap and no concrete noun is assigned.
types.uniform_lift: All nominal arguments and ordinary nominal anchors are now explicitly interpreted as nonempty finite groups G with every member satisfying Kind_X for each asserted X-description. This group lift is a NEW uniform type premise, not evidence that the old unspecified referents were already counted groups.
types.reference: Retain the5written anchor choices of IDEA95 exactly; they now refer to the same chosen group variable. Different variables impose no equality,inequality or disjointness.

operation.name: CountSpec
operation.input: A given finite nonempty group G and its fixed member-level kind X; G is not generated to have sizec.
operation.shared_parameter: One lexical c in positive integers, common to all10DAIIN constructions on both passages. No value selected.
operation.output: Assertion finite(G) AND |G|=c AND forall g inG:Kind_X(g).
operation.free_bound: Use the same assertion for existing X daiin and the finitely licensed daldaiin/doldaiin. No other compound split added.
operation.repeat: Repeating an assertion on the same group repeats the same condition; it does not doublec or manufacture anothergroup.
operation.other_markers: CTHY,CTHEY,DY,OR remain the original four unknown local relations on group referents. DAIN/DAIR/DAN/DAIIIN and whole QODAIIN/CHODAIIN receive no numeric mapping.

consequences: All10selected groups must be equinumerous; this is not identity ofgroups ormembers.
The two source-anchored DAL groups on f45r/f89r1 have equal cardinality, not necessarily equal membership.
For f89r1, five cardinalities equalc, but no5cunion total follows without pairwise disjointness.
Two independently bound unequal cardinalities would contradict the common-c contract. One reliable bound cardinality fixes c and constrains the others.
No group membership or real count is currently bound. Every positive c remains constructively possible; no empirical pass or number identification follows.
forbidden_repairs: per-head mass/volume units or quality axes
changing group boundaries or member individuation to obtainc
counting words,mentions,strokes or unowned pictured objects as members
fresh physical objects merely to avoid a conflict
summing overlapping or possibly identical groups
universal export of the local postfix grammar

decision_note.positive_basis: Exact repeated X-DAIIN constructions and finite free/bound bridges are established formal material. DAIIN is widespread and frequent; a reusable value function is compatible but not preferred. ExistingP14/IDEA157 supplies the quantity/grade candidate family, not a decoded numeral.
decision_note.predecessor_boundary: W94closed its fixed distinct-ratio-value extension and leaves absolutecommonvaluefree;W95head/unitlimits andW96parkedf2v remain.1167weakensoldI-IVmapping.1047blocksuniversalparagraph-localpostfixhost rule. Originalfamily/member/suffixalternatives remain.
decision_note.work: Author all10count assertions in the unchanged132group context; source-aligned projection, one small explicit cardinality function with transparent formal examples, independent semantic/accounting audit, word-reviewtool and publication.
decision_note.decision_by_outcome: A well-defined uniform constructor supplies a concrete conditional content reading, not meaning preference. Type/membership gaps stay visible. Stop if it needs per-head units,unwritten resets or numerical assignment to forcefit.
decision_note.wall_time_budget: 45minutes inclusive of preceding retrieval,authoring,formal checks and publication; no statistical/corpus expansion or larger decoder.
